Cloude Code:

name: AWS DevSecOps Pipeline

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, develop ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, develop ]
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 0'  # Weekly scan on Sundays

env:
  JAVA_VERSION: '17'
  AWS_REGION: 'us-east-1'
  ECR_REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
  SNYK_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SNYK_TOKEN }}
  SONAR_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SONAR_TOKEN }}
  JFROG_URL: ${{ secrets.JFROG_URL }}
  JFROG_USER: ${{ secrets.JFROG_USER }}
  JFROG_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.JFROG_TOKEN }}

jobs:
  # STAGE 1: SOURCE CODE ANALYSIS
  sast-code-scan:
    name: 1A - Static Code Analysis (SAST)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0  # Shallow clones disabled for better SonarCloud analysis
      
      - name: Set up JDK
        uses: actions/setup-java@v3
        with:
          java-version: ${{ env.JAVA_VERSION }}
          distribution: 'temurin'
          cache: maven
      
      - name: SonarCloud Scan
        run: mvn -B verify sonar:sonar -Dsonar.projectKey=${{ github.repository_owner }}_${{ github.event.repository.name }} -Dsonar.organization=${{ github.repository_owner }} -Dsonar.host.url=https://sonarcloud.io
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

  sca-dependency-scan:
    name: 1B - Software Composition Analysis
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
      
      - name: Set up JDK
        uses: actions/setup-java@v3
        with:
          java-version: ${{ env.JAVA_VERSION }}
          distribution: 'temurin'
          cache: maven
      
      - name: Snyk Open Source Scan
        uses: snyk/actions/maven@master
        with:
          command: test
      
      - name: Snyk Code Scan
        uses: snyk/actions/maven@master
        with:
          command: code test

  # STAGE 2: BUILD AND PACKAGE
  build-application:
    name: 2A - Build Application
    needs: [sast-code-scan, sca-dependency-scan]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
      
      - name: Set up JDK
        uses: actions/setup-java@v3
        with:
          java-version: ${{ env.JAVA_VERSION }}
          distribution: 'temurin'
          cache: maven
      
      - name: Maven Build
        run: mvn -B package -DskipTests
      
      - name: Upload Maven artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
        with:
          name: maven-artifacts
          path: target/*.jar

  jfrog-binary-scan:
    name: 2B - Binary Artifact Scanning
    needs: [build-application]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Download Maven artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v3
        with:
          name: maven-artifacts
          path: target/
      
      - name: JFrog Xray Scan
        uses: jfrog/setup-jfrog-cli@v3
        env:
          JF_URL: ${{ env.JFROG_URL }}
          JF_USER: ${{ env.JFROG_USER }}
          JF_PASSWORD: ${{ env.JFROG_TOKEN }}
        with:
          version: latest
      - run: |
          jfrog rt upload "target/*.jar" maven-repo/
          jfrog rt build-scan --fail=false

  # STAGE 3: CONTAINER BUILD AND SCAN
  container-security:
    name: 3 - Container Image Security
    needs: [jfrog-binary-scan]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
      
      - name: Download Maven artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v3
        with:
          name: maven-artifacts
          path: target/
      
      - name: Configure AWS credentials
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v1
        with:
          aws-access-key-id: ${{ secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
          aws-secret-access-key: ${{ secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
          aws-region: ${{ env.AWS_REGION }}
      
      - name: Login to Amazon ECR
        id: login-ecr
        uses: aws-actions/amazon-ecr-login@v1
      
      - name: Build, tag, and push image to Amazon ECR
        id: build-image
        env:
          ECR_REGISTRY: ${{ steps.login-ecr.outputs.registry }}
          IMAGE_TAG: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          # Create repository if it doesn't exist
          aws ecr describe-repositories --repository-names ${{ env.ECR_REPOSITORY }} || aws ecr create-repository --repository-name ${{ env.ECR_REPOSITORY }}
          
          # Build and tag the image but don't push yet
          docker build -t $ECR_REGISTRY/${{ env.ECR_REPOSITORY }}:$IMAGE_TAG .
          echo "::set-output name=image::$ECR_REGISTRY/${{ env.ECR_REPOSITORY }}:$IMAGE_TAG"
      
      - name: Trivy vulnerability scan
        uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@master
        with:
          image-ref: ${{ steps.build-image.outputs.image }}
          format: 'sarif'
          output: 'trivy-results.sarif'
          severity: 'CRITICAL,HIGH'
          exit-code: '0'  # Don't fail the pipeline
          ignore-unfixed: true
      
      - name: Upload Trivy scan results to GitHub Security tab
        uses: github/codeql-action/upload-sarif@v2
        if: always()
        with:
          sarif_file: 'trivy-results.sarif'
      
      - name: Snyk Container Scan
        uses: snyk/actions/docker@master
        with:
          image: ${{ steps.build-image.outputs.image }}
          args: --file=Dockerfile
      
      - name: Push Docker image to ECR (if on main or develop)
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/develop'
        env:
          ECR_REGISTRY: ${{ steps.login-ecr.outputs.registry }}
          IMAGE_TAG: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          # Add environment tag
          if [ "${{ github.ref }}" = "refs/heads/main" ]; then
            ENV_TAG="production"
          else
            ENV_TAG="staging"
          fi
          
          # Tag and push
          docker tag $ECR_REGISTRY/${{ env.ECR_REPOSITORY }}:$IMAGE_TAG $ECR_REGISTRY/${{ env.ECR_REPOSITORY }}:$ENV_TAG
          docker push $ECR_REGISTRY/${{ env.ECR_REPOSITORY }}:$IMAGE_TAG
          docker push $ECR_REGISTRY/${{ env.ECR_REPOSITORY }}:$ENV_TAG
          
          echo "::set-output name=env-tag::$ENV_TAG"

  # STAGE 4: INFRASTRUCTURE SECURITY
  infrastructure-security:
    name: 4 - CloudFormation & Terraform Security
    needs: [container-security]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
      
      - name: Snyk IaC Scan - CloudFormation
        uses: snyk/actions/iac@master
        with:
          args: --severity-threshold=high cloudformation/
      
      - name: Snyk IaC Scan - Terraform
        uses: snyk/actions/iac@master
        with:
          args: --severity-threshold=high terraform/
      
      - name: cfn-nag CloudFormation Security Scan
        uses: stelligent/cfn_nag@master
        with:
          input_path: cloudformation/
          extra_args: --output-format json --output-path cfn-nag-results.json
      
      - name: Upload CFN Nag Results
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
        with:
          name: cloudformation-security-scan
          path: cfn-nag-results.json

  # STAGE 5: TEST ENVIRONMENT DEPLOYMENT AND TESTING
  deploy-test:
    name: 5A - Deploy to AWS Staging Environment
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/develop'
    needs: [infrastructure-security]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: staging
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
      
      - name: Configure AWS credentials
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v1
        with:
          aws-access-key-id: ${{ secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
          aws-secret-access-key: ${{ secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
          aws-region: ${{ env.AWS_REGION }}
      
      - name: Login to Amazon ECR
        id: login-ecr
        uses: aws-actions/amazon-ecr-login@v1
      
      - name: Deploy to ECS (Staging Environment)
        run: |
          aws ecs update-service --cluster staging-cluster --service app-service --force-new-deployment
          
          # Wait for deployment to complete
          aws ecs wait services-stable --cluster staging-cluster --services app-service
          
          # Get the ALB DNS name for DAST testing
          ALB_DNS=$(aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name staging-stack --query "Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey=='AlbDnsName'].OutputValue" --output text)
          echo "TEST_APP_URL=http://$ALB_DNS" >> $GITHUB_ENV

  dast-testing:
    name: 5B - Dynamic Application Security Testing
    needs: [deploy-test]
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/develop'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
      
      - name: Wait for application to be fully available
        run: |
          # Allow some time for the application to fully initialize
          sleep 60
      
      - name: OWASP ZAP Full Scan
        uses: zaproxy/action-full-scan@v0.7.0
        with:
          target: ${{ env.TEST_APP_URL }}
          rules_file_name: '.zap/rules.tsv'
          cmd_options: '-a'
          allow_issue_writing: false
      
      - name: Upload ZAP Scan Results
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
        with:
          name: zap-scan-results
          path: zap-report/

  # STAGE 6: AWS SECURITY CHECKS
  aws-security:
    name: 6 - AWS Security Checks
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    needs: [infrastructure-security]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
      
      - name: Configure AWS credentials
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v1
        with:
          aws-access-key-id: ${{ secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
          aws-secret-access-key: ${{ secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
          aws-region: ${{ env.AWS_REGION }}
      
      - name: Install AWS CLI
        run: |
          pip install awscli
      
      - name: Install prowler for AWS security assessment
        run: |
          pip install prowler
      
      - name: Run Prowler for AWS security assessment
        run: |
          mkdir -p prowler-output
          prowler -c eks -M csv -F prowler-output
          prowler -c ec2 -M csv -F prowler-output
          prowler -c iam -M csv -F prowler-output
          prowler -c cloudtrail -M csv -F prowler-output
      
      - name: Run trivy-operator security scan on EKS
        run: |
          # Install kubectl
          curl -LO "https://dl.k8s.io/release/v1.24.0/bin/linux/amd64/kubectl"
          chmod +x kubectl
          sudo mv kubectl /usr/local/bin/
          
          # Configure kubectl
          aws eks update-kubeconfig --name production-cluster --region ${{ env.AWS_REGION }}
          
          # Install Trivy Operator using Helm
          helm repo add aqua https://aquasecurity.github.io/helm-charts/
          helm repo update
          helm upgrade --install trivy-operator aqua/trivy-operator \
            --namespace trivy-system \
            --create-namespace
          
          # Run vulnerability scans
          kubectl wait --for=condition=available --timeout=600s deployment/trivy-operator -n trivy-system
          kubectl apply -f .github/workflows/trivy-vuln-scan.yaml
          
          # Wait for scan to complete
          sleep 60
          
          # Get scan results
          kubectl get vulnerabilityreports -A -o yaml > trivy-vuln-results.yaml
      
      - name: Upload AWS Security Reports
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
        with:
          name: aws-security-reports
          path: |
            prowler-output/
            trivy-vuln-results.yaml

  # STAGE 7: PRODUCTION DEPLOYMENT WITH FALCO
  deploy-production:
    name: 7A - Production Deployment (Blue-Green on ECS)
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    needs: [aws-security]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: production
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
      
      - name: Configure AWS credentials
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v1
        with:
          aws-access-key-id: ${{ secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
          aws-secret-access-key: ${{ secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
          aws-region: ${{ env.AWS_REGION }}
      
      - name: Login to Amazon ECR
        id: login-ecr
        uses: aws-actions/amazon-ecr-login@v1
      
      - name: Deploy to ECS with Blue-Green strategy
        run: |
          # Determine the current active deployment
          CURRENT_TASK_DEF=$(aws ecs describe-services --cluster production-cluster --services app-service --query "services[0].taskDefinition" --output text)
          
          # Create new task definition (green)
          aws ecs register-task-definition --cli-input-json file://ecs/task-definition.json
          NEW_TASK_DEF=$(aws ecs describe-task-definition --task-definition app --query "taskDefinition.taskDefinitionArn" --output text)
          
          # Update the service with the new task definition
          aws ecs update-service --cluster production-cluster --service app-service --task-definition $NEW_TASK_DEF
          
          # Wait for deployment to complete
          aws ecs wait services-stable --cluster production-cluster --services app-service
          
          # If everything is good, we don't need to rollback
          # If there's an issue, we could revert to the previous task definition
          # aws ecs update-service --cluster production-cluster --service app-service --task-definition $CURRENT_TASK_DEF

  runtime-security:
    name: 7B - Runtime Security with Falco on EKS
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    needs: [deploy-production]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
      
      - name: Configure AWS credentials
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v1
        with:
          aws-access-key-id: ${{ secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
          aws-secret-access-key: ${{ secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
          aws-region: ${{ env.AWS_REGION }}
      
      - name: Configure kubectl
        run: |
          aws eks update-kubeconfig --name production-cluster --region ${{ env.AWS_REGION }}
      
      - name: Deploy Falco
        run: |
          # Install Falco using Helm
          helm repo add falcosecurity https://falcosecurity.github.io/charts
          helm repo update
          helm upgrade --install falco falcosecurity/falco \
            --namespace falco \
            --create-namespace \
            --set driver.kind=ebpf \
            --set tty=true \
            --set falcosidekick.enabled=true \
            --set falcosidekick.slack.webhookurl=${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }} \
            --set falcosidekick.aws.lambdaFunction.enabled=true \
            --set falcosidekick.aws.lambdaFunction.functionName=falco-response \
            --set falcosidekick.aws.region=${{ env.AWS_REGION }}
      
      - name: Verify Falco Installation
        run: |
          kubectl get pods -n falco
          kubectl logs -n falco -l app.kubernetes.io/name=falco --tail=20
      
      - name: Apply Falco Custom Rules
        run: |
          kubectl create configmap -n falco falco-custom-rules --from-file=./security/falco-rules/custom-rules.yaml || true
          kubectl patch deployment -n falco falco -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"volumes":[{"name":"custom-rules","configMap":{"name":"falco-custom-rules"}}]}}}}'

  # STAGE 8: POST-DEPLOYMENT VERIFICATION
  security-monitoring:
    name: 8 - AWS Security Monitoring Setup
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    needs: [runtime-security]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
      
      - name: Configure AWS credentials
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v1
        with:
          aws-access-key-id: ${{ secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
          aws-secret-access-key: ${{ secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
          aws-region: ${{ env.AWS_REGION }}
      
      - name: Setup Security Monitoring with AWS Security Hub
        run: |
          # Enable AWS Security Hub if not already enabled
          aws securityhub describe-hub || aws securityhub enable-security-hub
          
          # Enable security standards
          aws securityhub batch-enable-standards --standards-subscription-requests '[{"StandardsArn":"arn:aws:securityhub:'"${{ env.AWS_REGION }}"':standards/aws-foundational-security-best-practices/v/1.0.0"}]'
          aws securityhub batch-enable-standards --standards-subscription-requests '[{"StandardsArn":"arn:aws:securityhub:'"${{ env.AWS_REGION }}"':standards/cis-aws-foundations-benchmark/v/1.2.0"}]'
      
      - name: Configure AWS GuardDuty
        run: |
          # Enable GuardDuty if not already enabled
          aws guardduty list-detectors || aws guardduty create-detector --enable
      
      - name: Setup AWS Config for Compliance Monitoring
        run: |
          # Enable AWS Config if needed
          aws configservice describe-configuration-recorders || aws configservice put-configuration-recorder --configuration-recorder name=default,roleARN=arn:aws:iam::${{ github.event.repository.owner.id }}:role/aws-service-role/config.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForConfig --recording-group allSupported=true,includeGlobalResources=true
      
      - name: Create CloudWatch Dashboard for Security Monitoring
        run: |
          # Create a CloudWatch dashboard for monitoring security metrics
          aws cloudwatch put-dashboard --dashboard-name SecurityMonitoring --dashboard-body file://cloudwatch/security-dashboard.json
      
      - name: Notify Security Team
        if: always()
        uses: 8398a7/action-slack@v3
        with:
          status: ${{ job.status }}
          fields: repo,message,commit,author,action,eventName,ref,workflow
        env:
          SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
